visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men wearing white chef uniforms stand in a studio with a white brick background. A table in front of them holds a bottle of Coca-Cola, a carton of chocolate milk, orange juice, and other beverages. A blue speech bubble graphic appears above a tablet displaying recipes. (2) The scene cuts to the men holding wine glasses filled with a dark liquid. They are tasting ice Americano mixed with grape juice. One man swirls his glass while the other speaks animatedly. A graphic overlay lists four mixing methods. (3) A close-up shows Coca-Cola being poured into a glass already containing coffee. The men taste the mixture, reacting with expressions of intrigue and laughter. They point at the glasses while talking. (4) The duo tastes a mixture of coffee and orange juice. One chef looks skeptical while the other continues to explain. Bottles of the mixers are placed prominently on the table. (5) They sample coffee mixed with chocolate milk. Their facial expressions shift to disappointment and they shake their heads. The video ends with them gesturing towards the camera and giving a final summary.

The voices maintain a friendly, conversational tone with frequent pitch shifts during tasting. (3) A fizzing sound of a carbonated drink pouring occurs. The men's laughter overlaps with the BGM. A 'whoosh' transition SFX signifies a scene change. (4) The BGM continues steadily at a moderate tempo. One male voice uses a playful, exaggerated tone to describe the orange coffee. Another 'ding' SFX signals the final mix. (5) A cartoon-style 'negative' SFX (dissonant chime) plays as they sample the chocolate milk mixture. The vocal intensity lowers slightly to match the disappointment, then ramps up for the outro.
